mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.run_message (tenant_id, run_id, step_number, role, content, tool_operation_id, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, fencing_token, idem_key) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{stepNumber}, #{role}, #{contentJson}::jsonb, #{toolOperationId}::uuid, #{modelId}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{fencingToken}, #{idemKey}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, run_id, idem_key) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, tool_operation_id = EXCLUDED.tool_operation_id, model_id = EXCLUDED.model_id, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, latency_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_ms, fencing_token = EXCLUDED.fencing_token
